ac1_durable_owner_and_process_dict_remov.details: Servant session messages (user and assistant) persist through AgoraWriteService.append_session_message -> AgoraStore.append_session_message in services/agora/store.py using compare-and-set on agora.sessions (mode='servant') with idempotency on message_id. Process-local _SERVANT_SESSION_EVENTS and _SERVANT_EVENT_LOCK are removed from services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/router.py.

ac2_queued_202_and_worker_execution_stre.details: POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/messages appends the user message to the Agora owner, durably queues a turn in agora.servant_turns via enqueue_servant_turn, and immediately returns 202 Accepted with provider.status='queued' (AD-AG-05). ServantTurnWorker (services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/turn_worker.py), wired into scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py (--once and continuous background loop with SERVANT_HEARTBEAT_PATH), claims queued or lease-expired turns, invokes OpenClaw, appends the assistant reply via append_session_message, and settles the turn. GET /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/stream projects durable messages and in-flight turns from the Agora owner.

ac3_turn_carries_last_20_messages.details: history_for_turn in services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/turn_worker.py slices the last SERVANT_HISTORY_MESSAGES = 20 messages up to and including the turn's user message and passes them to invoke_assistant_provider. Verified by test_servant_turn_carries_last_20_messages.

ac4_restart_and_no_provider_in_request_t.details: test_servant_history_survives_bff_restart builds a fresh FastAPI BFF app and AgoraWriteService instance over the same underlying owner table rows, confirms hasattr(servant_router, '_SERVANT_SESSION_EVENTS') is False, verifies /stream replays the identical event history, and verifies a follow-up turn carries the earlier turn in its prompt history. test_servant_message_request_makes_no_provider_call replaces invoke_assistant_provider with a raising stub and proves POST /messages returns 202 with status='queued' without calling the provider.

ac5_runtime_budget_and_storage_manifest.details: Per-message budget: SERVANT_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS = 4000 (~2 KB typical; request validates max_length=4000 and owner truncates long assistant replies). Per-session cap: SERVANT_MESSAGE_CAP = 500 messages per session (409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT on the 501st message). Retention and cleanup path: SERVANT_SESSION_RETENTION_DAYS = 180 days, cleaned by AgoraWriteService.purge_expired_servant_sessions / AgoraStore.purge_expired_servant_sessions (invoked hourly by ServantTurnWorker.maybe_purge). Registered in docs/operations/storage-manifest.json under schema_table agora.servant_turns (bound_status='bounded') and verified by scripts/check_storage_manifest.py.

ac6_hosted_proof.details: Requires deployment of this PR to hosted dev (operator-bff and agora-interaction-worker); worker sandbox has no hosted dev credentials or SSH/gcloud access. Post-deploy verification procedure: authenticate as dev trader (admintest), POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions, POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/messages (assert 202 provider.status='queued'), read GET /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/stream after agora-interaction-worker processes the turn (assert servant.message.completed), restart operator-bff container, and re-read GET /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/stream (assert identical message history survives BFF restart).

runtime_budget.cadence: event-driven on trader POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/messages (1 turn row + 1 user message on admission, 1 assistant message + turn settlement by agora-interaction-worker); hourly cleanup check via ServantTurnWorker.maybe_purge
runtime_budget.size_per_message: about 2 KB typical (SERVANT_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS = 4000 chars cap per message; ~1 KB per turn row in agora.servant_turns)
runtime_budget.cap_per_session: 500 messages per session (SERVANT_MESSAGE_CAP = 500; at most 250 user turns per session)
runtime_budget.cleanup_path: AgoraWriteService.purge_expired_servant_sessions -> AgoraStore.purge_expired_servant_sessions (called hourly by ServantTurnWorker.maybe_purge in scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py)
